$comment: The (login step × re-entry kind) cells the derived suite (scenarios/derived-scenarios.ts) does NOT cover,
each with the reason and what unblocks it. framework/derived-coverage.test.ts fails on an unregistered
empty cell and on a registered cell the generator now covers: a gap is named or it does not exist.

gaps.login-email × back: Back on the first step leaves the login for the RP's page: nothing of the login is re-entered. Structural.
gaps.login-email × back-resubmit: The identifier step is never the last page of a completed login. Structural.
gaps.tenant-selection × back: Where one real Back lands from the tenant selection is unmeasured; BACK_LANDS_ON lists measured landings only. Unblocked by measuring it on canonical-portal.
gaps.tenant-selection × back-resubmit: The tenant selection is never the last page of a completed login. Structural.
gaps.login-password × back-resubmit: No base shape ends password → callback with a stale page to resubmit: login-mfa-off's password step is replaced in history, not pushed (BACK_LANDS_ON). Unblocked by a measured landing for it.
gaps.login-webauthn-verify × reload: No eligible base walks the key assertion: oidc-webauthn-assertion is multi-phase (the key is enrolled first). Unblocked by the generator accepting a later phase as a base.
gaps.login-webauthn-verify × back-resubmit: Kratos's script submits the key as a form and no frontend code sees the answer (login-ui#987 scope); and no eligible base.
gaps.login-backup-code-verify × reload: Backup codes are one-shot: a base that spends one needs a re-seed between runs, so it is excluded from derivation (lookup_secret). Unblocked by a per-walk code fetch in the generator.
